aliases: 8MP AI Bullet 카메라 (8MP AI Bullet Camera)
features: AI object detection & classification: person, face, vehicle, license plate (with attributes)
AI analytics: virtual line/area, loitering, intrusion, fall detection, face-mask detection, social distancing
AI business intelligence: people / vehicle / crowd counting, queue management
Dual NPU, Wisepower power monitoring, redundant power input
Device certificate (Hanwha Vision Root CA), secure boot, SBOM, ETSI EN 303 645
Korean national security function verification (보안기능 확인서) product
Audio in (selectable mic/line in) + line out
IP66/IP67, IK10, NEMA 4X, NEMA TS 2 (+74 C max)

frigate.notes: Hanwha profiles: profile1=MJPEG, profile2=main, profile3=sub (default Wisenet profile layout); not yet verified on this model.

release_notes: Specs per official Hanwha Vision datasheet (DataSheet_PNO-A9082RK_20260703_KO_105413.pdf, Korean). Korea-market security-certified (K) variant. The datasheet lists no ONVIF profile and no microSD slot, so onvif and storage are omitted; RTSP/HTTPS and SUNAPI listed. Power consumption is the PoE max (12VDC max 16.5W). Startup at -30 C or above; +74 C max per NEMA TS 2.
